'UBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, April 18, 2023, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Layboum, Dr. Rinne and Tom
Segrave.

AGENDA ITEMS

9. ORDINANCE -2™ READING ~ Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located west of Ridge Road, between Jackson Street and Douglas Street. (SPONSOR —
MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne joined the meeting at 12:02 p.m. during the staff report on item #9.

Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on 2"! reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Erin Fagan, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Dr. Rinne
commented on the item.

10. ORDINANCE -2™ READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of MR Medium-Density Residential for
land being annexed to the City of Cheyenne located at $224 Ridge Road (west of Ridge
Road, between Jackson Street and Douglas Street). (SPONSOR — MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on 2" reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Erin Fagan, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Chairman Cook
commented on the item.

11. ORDINANCE -2™ READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MR Medium-Density Residential to
NR-2 Neighborhood Residential - Medium Density for land located on Lots | and 2, Block
1, Twin 22 Subdivision, (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Lonnie Olson, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brandon Swain,
developer, provided additional information. Committee member Laybourn commented on the
item.
